dialogues.speaker: Ororon
dialogues.text: Earlier on, that lady with the pink hair took a picture of Ajaw and Cacucu together.

dialogues.speaker: Ifa
dialogues.text: You sound a little disappointed. Were you hoping to be in it too?

dialogues.speaker: Ororon
dialogues.text: But after seeing how awkward Ajaw looked, I figured I wouldn't really fit in.

dialogues.speaker: Ajaw
dialogues.text: Huh!? And you didn't think of sharing this any sooner!?

dialogues.speaker: Ajaw
dialogues.text: I'd have cuddled your neck and smiled for the Kamera! Anything to get out of being in the same frame as that thing!

dialogues.speaker: Ororon
dialogues.text: Really? Well no worries, you still can. Come here, give us a hug!

dialogues.speaker: Ajaw
dialogues.text: I hope your face is ready, 'cause it's about to get flame-roasted!

dialogues.speaker: Ifa
dialogues.text: Kinich, have you thought about maybe... ditching that little rascal? Leaving him here for good when you leave?

dialogues.speaker: Kinich
dialogues.text: I have. But given that Ajaw's also an old relic, that would probably count as international smuggling.

dialogues.speaker: Kinich
dialogues.text: I can't bring myself to knowingly break the law.

dialogues.speaker: Ifa
dialogues.text: Haha, guess we all have our problems in life.
